Ghostly beautiful young woman with long flowing white hair and translucent skin glowing softly with pale blue spirit light, wearing ethereal flowing white robes that drift and move as if underwater, standing in the center of the ghost realm with an expression of profound sorrow and unconditional love, her form flickering slightly like candlelight. Close-up on her translucent ghostly hands reaching out toward someone just outside the frame — fingers slightly spread as if catching someone. The scene darkens around her as she closes her eyes and begins to dissolve into thousands of glowing spirit particles rising into the dark purple sky, her final tear falling in slow motion. Wide establishing shot reveals a young male cultivator in simple dark robes kneeling alone in the ghost realm where she stood, reaching for fading light, confused and hollow. Golden sunrise breaking over misty ancient Chinese cultivation mountains, mist rising from valleys, birds beginning to sing, morning light warm and healing — symbolizing the cycle continuing, tragedy giving way to hope.
